integrity: The generator is decoded directly from the published hexadecimal rows. Exact finite enumeration verifies the LCD property, all codewords, every binary subspace of the seven-dimensional coefficient space, and the complete higher-support hierarchy.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the explicit new optimal binary LCD \([55,7,25]\) representative published in arXiv:2609.02096v1. It does not classify all optimal codes with these ordinary parameters or claim equivalence among other representatives.
title: Complete support profile of the new optimal binary LCD \([55,7,25]\) code
